text:
alex: Heads-up — multiple customer reports (acme-corp) of a p99 latency spike on /v1/generate starting ~09:13 UTC. p95 jumped from ~320ms -> 1.2s; p99 from ~1.6s -> ~4.8s. Error rate stable, just tail latency. Seen primarily in us-west-2. Can oncall triage?
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-451 created for latency spike (severity: degraded). Pager sent to @mira oncall.
mira: Oncall — I’m taking this. Pulling perf dashboards now (prod /v1/generate). Quick checks: 1) any recent deploys to runtime? 2) queue lengths on redis batching? 3) node oom or host-level throttling?
alex: No deploys in last 40m according to deploy-bot, infra looked quiet earlier. Redis backlog slightly higher for the route.
mira: Querying metrics: running prometheus snippet:```rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",env="prod"}[5m])``` p95/p99 histograms show heavier tail on sequence lengths >512. Also seeing KV cache miss rate up ~12%.
sam: Noted. Could be cache invalidation or an unlucky distribution change. Suggest immediate mitigations: - Enable per-org throttling for acme-corp to limit to 30rps (soft) - Route acme-corp to fallback model variant (quantized smaller) - Shorten max_tokens for that org temporarily
mira: Actions I can run now: 1) apply soft rate limit in API gateway 2) flip routing rule to fallback model (redwood-llm-13b-8q) for acme-corp 3) if needed, shift traffic to eu-west-1 region where queueing is lower. Which should we prioritize?
alex: Start with throttling + fallback model. Those are lowest friction and reversible. If tail persists, move region. Also add 429 + Retry-After so callers back off gracefully.
mira: Executing: ```# apply soft rate limit (gateway) curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/limits -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"org":"acme-corp","route":"/v1/generate","qps":30}'``` Will roll out to edge in ~15s.
mira: Applying fallback rule: ```# route override curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/routing -d '{"org":"acme-corp","route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood-13b-8q","reason":"p99 spike mitigation"}'``` This will send new sessions to fallback; existing sessions keep current model for now.
sam: Pls also enable circuit-breaker on that route to open if latency > 2s for 1m. Config snippet: ```circuit_breaker: threshold_ms:2000 window:60s action:failover``` If we open, fallback to hosted small model or return 503/429 based on policy.
mira: Circuit breaker enabled (config pushed). Also increased KV cache prefetch for frequent prefixes; hope to reduce misses.
eng-runtime: FYI we see increased kernel time on a subset of GPU instances in us-west-2 (nvlink congestion + attention kernel stall on long sequences). We'll run a quick repro on a dev pod and check for model-specific kernel regressions.
alex: Repro steps for anyone trying locally: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -H 'x-org-id: acme-corp' -d '{"prompt":"<long prompt ~700 tokens>","max_tokens":512}' -o /tmp/resp && tail -n 200 /tmp/resp``` Run several in parallel (5-10) to see queuing.
mira: After throttle+fallback+circuit-breaker applied: p95 back to ~360ms within 90s; p99 dropped to ~1.1s. KV cache miss rate trending down. Still monitoring. Turning on extended traces for 60m for this org.
sam: Nice. Next steps: 1) eng-runtime to finish kernel repro and confirm whether regression or just distribution change. 2) product ops to contact acme-corp with mitigation steps and temporary limits. 3) consider SLO guardrail changes: lower default max concurrency for large-seq endpoints, auto-fallback thresholds for p99>2s.
eng-runtime: Working on repro job now — will log exact kernel timings and check if recent kernel selection logic changed for long-seq paths. If confirmed, we’ll push a rollback or alternative kernel selection to canary.
alex: Ops note for postmortem: collect sample traces, CPU/GPU timelines, KV cache keys for the window, and list of client-side concurrency for acme-corp. Add suggested changes to SLO guardrails doc: - per-org burst caps - automatic fallback to smaller model if p99 > 2s for 3 consecutive minutes - circuit-breaker default for generation routes with threshold_ms=1500 - prefer returning 429 + Retry-After over silent queueing
mira: I'll keep monitoring. If anyone notices errors increase (5xx) or we see slowdowns in fallback region, ping immediately. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-451 updated: mitigations applied (rate-limit, fallback model, circuit-breaker). Monitoring window started.
alex: Great job. Leave this thread open until we're stable for 30m and then we can convert to a postmortem.
mira: Agreed — will update status in 30m or earlier.
sam: I'll draft a quick runbook blurb for the next oncall: when p99>2s -> apply soft throttle -> fallback model -> circuit breaker -> region shift -> escalate to eng-runtime. Will attach to SLO guardrails doc.
mira: Thanks — closing loop when stable.
